Context: 6. Proceedings after Retirement

6. Departmental proceedings after retirement cannot be instituted in respect of any event which took place or the cause of action arose more than four years before such institution. The sanction of the President is necessary to institute departmental proceedings after retirement.  
- Rule 8 (2) (c).
